# Sodium High-Pressure Causal Map

Low pressure:

$$
Na_{\rm bcc}
$$

Apply:

$$
P\uparrow
$$

Observed structural sequence:

$$
bcc
\rightarrow
fcc
\rightarrow
cI16
\rightarrow
oP8
\rightarrow
tI19
\rightarrow
hP4
$$

At hP4:

$$
\text{core overlap}
+
p-d\ \text{hybridization}
+
\text{interstitial electron localization}
$$

leads to:

$$
\boxed{
\text{transparent insulating electride state}
}
$$

This is a direct Causali E example:

  composition: Na
